prompts.initial: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square premium natural studio photograph-style CONCEPT preview of a new four-bottle insulated wine carrier. References are MATERIAL TEXTURE ONLY, not same product evidence: first photo matte nonwoven fabric, second thin creased aluminum foil. New design: tall rectangular soft-sided bag, body width and depth approximately equal, body height about 1.45 times width, muted burgundy matte nonwoven exterior, fine random fibers and tiny heat-bond dots, NO canvas weave. Black edge binding and exactly TWO black webbing loop handles, one front one back; each handle's two vertical webbing legs extend down its face to lower base seam. A three-sided black zipper top lid hinged at the rear. Lid open tilted back, thin metallic creased aluminum foil underside and foil-lined inside walls. Inside exactly FOUR square cells in a 2x2 arrangement formed by ONE crossed divider system, full height to bottle shoulders, burgundy nonwoven panels with black top binding, fixed to inside walls. Four plain dark green wine bottles with black capsule tops, no labels, upright in cells, tops entirely BELOW the zipper rim with closure clearance. Modest rectangular footprint with bottle separation, not a giant bag. Front 3/4 slightly elevated angle makes four bottle tops and center cross divider visible, also front handle attachment. Handles drape naturally outside opening, never intersect bottles or lid. Body gently flexible, not rigid cooler, thin foil not thick padded silver fabric. Grounded soft contact shadow on seamless #F6F6F4, soft daylight, crisp honest fibers and stitching, subtle imperfections, balanced 12% margins, entire product and handles visible, no text, arrows, brand logo, watermark, dimensions, extra props. This is an original internal concept illustration, not evidence of manufactured sample.
